title: Kānaha Beach Park graywater reuse project
summary: The commission approved a coastal zone permit on November 26, 2024, for a graywater system at Kānaha Beach Park in Central Maui, sought by the Department of Water Supply. The Department of Health has approved the project, and the county planner said it would save 14.4 million gallons of water a year. The system shuts down automatically if tsunami salt water reaches it, and irrigation switches to county water, kept separate by an air gap, if treated water runs low.
